summary: The custody pilot for FS-GG/.github#4710 (C-J1) is .github/workflows/wasm-custody-pilot.yml, job custody-pilot. It runs only on workflow_dispatch; pull requests run static controls. It runs pilot_sequence from the inline caller in fable-reference-public.yml inside one sudo systemd-run delegated unit (TasksMax=4096, MemoryMax=8G, RuntimeMaxSec=1800), with a 30-minute job, contents: read and no secrets. Each admission admits exactly one dispatch. Validation requires main, admitted_ref equal to SHA, WORKFLOW_SHA and the checked-out head, the recorded admission URL, the workflow identity, the unit name and attempt 1. The first run (admission 6346457201) is retained evidence. The second run (admission 6347853904) adds the following. A pre-unit step installs exactly deps[ubuntu24.04-x64].webkit of the pinned playwright-core 1.63.0 bundle (51 packages, no tools group) and records dpkg-query before and after, the diff, the apt sources and the exit code; it runs only on attempt 1, with a 5-minute timeout and continue-on-error, apt-get update does not gate the install, it is never fatal, and results are labelled ubuntu-24.04 + recorded packages. The unit's properties are read back via systemctl show as a managed group. A survivor case per family uses a detached holder that keeps the browser alive after the leader exits. leftover-retired requires a launch-descendant browser process (not only the holder) among the residual pids, followed by contained retirement; a holder launch failure is kept as evidence. Forced cases record observedBrowserMembers, the launched browser processes in the owner's member sample; that sample covers every member observed, so it does not show which processes were held at the deadline. Hidden evidence files are included. Per family there are normal, forced, exit and survivor cases plus the Chromium library scan; stock host validation runs per family and is non-fatal. Each case counts only when contained, removed and free of escapes. Lessons: Playwright kills its browser when the launching process exits, so survivor retirement needs a detached holder; and sudo is unavailable inside a NoNewPrivileges unit, so host packages must be installed before the unit. Installed C stays held.
title: Dispatch-only WASM custody pilot admits one run per admission; the second adds WebKit packages and survivors
